## Triage: first grade · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-15T20:51Z

Read fresh. In a `record:details` copy-on-activate row (`role=button`, `tabindex=0`), `DetailSection`'s `onKeyDown` calls `preventDefault` on Enter whatever the target is. Enter on a lookup link inside the row therefore copies the row's raw value instead of navigating.
- The measured instance is the served approval request page's target card ("ACC-000002 - Globex Industries").
- Mouse clicks are unaffected.
- On 15 HotCRM business record pages the lookup links sit in rows without a copy handler, and Enter navigates there.
- Confirmed live by seat 1, and the same on `main` and PR #12568's head.

**Grade p3:** a keyboard user cannot follow one link kind from its row. The mouse path works, and today's reach is the pointer card's inner links.

**Lane `domain:ui`** (`@object-ui/plugin-detail` `DetailSection`).

**Direction:** the card's own. The row's handler ignores a key whose target is an interactive descendant (link, button, input) and lets it activate itself. ⛔ Not a per-link `stopPropagation` workaround: PR #12568's title-link stop stays, but the fix is the row's.

**Pins:**
- Enter on a descendant link navigates and copies nothing;
- Enter on the row itself still copies;
- CONTROL: Space and Escape behave as today.

`finding` leaves on grading.

Claim: PM loop round 1 (`priority:p3`; graded by triage `6202033912`)
Session: `session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB`

Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#1`
File surface:
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx`: the copy-on-activate row's key handler only, in both of its row shapes (the mobile grouped-inset row and the default row).
- The tests beside it, under `packages/plugin-detail/src/`.
- One served-page pin under `apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource.*.test.tsx`, mounting the root `SchemaRendererProvider` as `ConsoleShell.tsx:306` does, if the dev's measurement needs the served page.
- One `.changeset/12569-*.md`.

Outside the surface: a per-link `stopPropagation` workaround (the triage direction rules it out; PR objectui#12568's title-link stop in `record-preview/` stays), the row's click handler, and any prop or export (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` names no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `@object-ui/plugin-detail`'s `DetailSection` row handler calls `preventDefault` on Enter whatever the target is | none: no platform path lets a descendant link take its own Enter inside that row | a keyboard user on any record details row that offers copy and draws a link inside it; today that is the served approval request page's target card, and the mouse path works
Thread-read: 6202033912
Serial constraints cleared: read at objectui `main` after objectui#12553's landing (`0d2ac90555`).
- No open PR changes `packages/plugin-detail/`: PRs objectui#12561, #12571, #12572 and #12546 were diffed against `main` (0 hits), and PR objectui#12574 touches only `approval-decision/`, the console pins, the app-shell README and a changeset.
- No in-flight claim names `plugin-detail/` (objectui#12559, #12528 and #12500 on seat 2; objectui#12510, #12514, #12515 and #12522 on seat 4, all Studio surfaces).

## Landed · `domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB` · 2026-10-15T22:13Z

- **Merged:** PR #12577 landed through the merge queue as `main` `6f5dc6b30c` at 2026-10-15T22:05Z. It has one parent, `e089a25b9b`, and is an ancestor of `origin/main`.
- **Verified by content:** all 4 files the PR changes are blob-identical on `6f5dc6b30c` to the accepted head `6ace8cb335`, and the squash touches no other file.
- **Mis-close scan:** the PR body's only closing keyword is `Fixes #12569`. The only issue closed with this merge is this card, as `completed`; objectui#12573 closed separately, through seat 2's own PR.
- **What now holds:**
  - A read-only details row that offers copy acts on Enter or Space only when the key is pressed on the row itself, in both the default row and the phone layout's grouped row.
  - A key pressed on a link, a button or anything focusable inside the row is left to it: Enter on a lookup link opens the record and copies nothing.
  - On HotCRM's served approval request page, Enter on the target card's Account link opens "Globex Industries" at 1440 and at 390; Enter and Space on the Record ID row still copy the record id (ACCEPT `6203069243`).
- **The chain:** triage grade `6202033912`, claim `6202171309`, ACCEPT `6203069243`.
